vis.last.output_selection: tensor output of global-transformer block 7 of 8 (B, 4x1608, 1280)
vis.last.token_rule: the 1601 rows (CLS + 1600 patches) of each real 560x560 tile; the 7 zero-padding rows per tile and the padding tiles are not consumed
vis.last.affected_branch: global-transformer stream = dims [0:1280) of the 7680-d tensor the projector reads
vis.last.bypasses: local-transformer layer [3, 7, 15, 23, 30] outputs (5x1280 dims of the projector input) bypass this block
vis.last.notes: single tile per image (longer side resized to 560 before the processor); CLS is consumed by the cross-attention and is included; padding rows are sliced off before the projector

connector.output_selection: tensor output of multi_modal_projector (Linear 7680->4096), (B, 1, 4, 1601, D) viewed as (B, 4x1601, D)
connector.token_rule: the 1601 rows of each real tile (cross_attention_mask admits them all)
connector.affected_branch: keys/values of the cross-attention decoder layers
